en: A multi-view color postcard with three images. The top image shows a panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by high green mountains. The bottom left image depicts a brick church or abbey with a decorative fountain in front, set in a landscaped garden. The bottom right image shows a medieval hilltop castle ruin covered in greenery. Across the center, there is printed text reading "Saluti da PERGINE VALSUGANA".
